hosting._comment: auntieos-ttpc (= auntie.tribetails.com) now serves the REACT app, deployed from the auntieos-admin repo. This Compose wasm build deploys to the auntieos-admin site instead, so a wasm deploy can never overwrite the live React app. Desktop JVM is unaffected: it shares commonMain and ships as a local app, not via hosting.
